evidence: Modifies the fuzz harness in `src/test/fuzz/torcontrol.cpp` and test utility in `src/test/util/net.cpp` with the Fuzzing label.
rationale: Substantially expands fuzz coverage for Tor control wire parsing and fixes a socket-lifetime bug in `DynSock::Wait()`. The author notes that line coverage for `src/torcontrol.cpp` increases from 52% to 81%, allowing the fuzzer to explore wire parsing and full handshake success paths previously bypassed by 16-byte dummy callbacks.
